text: Amy wanted to be warned in time about the cracking ice. Jo hurried off toward the house. Left unwarned, she went down through the ice.

Jo wished to ring the chapel bell before the service began. Meg hurried up the path first. Held back at the door, she never rang it and was sorry.

Amy longed to pick apples in the orchard that afternoon. Meg ran off toward the barn instead. Standing by the empty tree, she never picked a single one and was sorry.

Tom wanted to reach the mill before the miller closed the gate. Laurie strode off toward the stable. Running the last stretch, he arrived just in time and was glad.

Laurie wished to reach the summit before the others. Sid pressed on quickly up the ridge. Far below on the rocks, he never gained the top and was sorry.
